costs.recentRunsHint: A run groups the calls of one action. Expand to see each call.

quotas.usersDescription: Each user's limit is their plan's monthly budget (all features). Resetting restarts the count from now. No cost data is deleted: real spend stays intact for analytics.
quotas.footnote: A reset only moves the start of the counted window. The cost ledger (ai_usage) is never modified — the AI costs tab still shows the full spend.
